usedFor: EmailOctopus holds campaigns and contacts, and HubSpot receives a deal through “Create Deal” when a recipient acts.

bestTemplate.name: “Email Clicked” in EmailOctopus, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A click shows interest, so “Create Deal” opens a HubSpot deal for sales to follow up.

watchOut: “Contact Is Updated” runs on every update, so the same contact can trigger “Create Deal” more than once.
